name: pad occupancy time
definition: Aggregated approach and landing pad occupation

name: gate turnaround time
definition: Time at gate including charging or passenger process

name: passenger load factor
definition: Occupied seats divided by available seats
notes: Preis 2023 baseline; must not be treated as observed demand.

name: passenger arrival window
definition: Passenger arrival before scheduled departure

name: counter check-in share
definition: Share of passengers using staffed counter

name: kiosk check-in share
definition: Share of passengers using kiosk

name: online check-in share
definition: Share of passengers arriving pre-checked-in

name: boarding time
definition: Passenger boarding process duration

name: deboarding time
definition: Passenger deboarding process duration

name: charging power
definition: Charging power available to an eVTOL

name: battery swap duration
definition: Duration of battery swapping
notes: Preis and Hornung 2022 expert-based value. Not in base case by modelling choice: Reg. (EU) 2024/1111 UAM.OP.MVCA.205 allows swapping (also with passengers) under SOP and training; EASA CRD 2022-06 p. 90 treats swap as maintenance; surveyed OEMs plan no swapping. Exploratory scenario only.

name: gate service time
definition: Aircraft gate sequence including charge passenger process and buffer

name: TLOF movement time
definition: Time assigned to one TLOF movement

name: aircraft arrival rate
definition: Arrival intensity at the vertiport

name: FAA TLOF diameter
definition: Minimum touchdown and lift-off area dimension
notes: FAA EB 105A geometry requirement; not an operational service time.

name: FAA FATO diameter
definition: Minimum final approach and take-off area dimension

name: FAA safety area
definition: Minimum safety area dimension

name: EASA FATO diameter
definition: Minimum final approach and take-off area dimension
value_or_range: at least 1.5 D or AFM dimension
notes: EASA prototype technical specification; vehicle-specific AFM input required.

name: EASA stand envelope
definition: Stand diameter for eVTOL
notes: EASA prototype technical specification; not a stand service-time proxy.

name: EASA air-taxi speed
definition: Maximum air-taxi route speed
notes: EASA prototype technical specification; translate to travel time only after route length is specified.

name: weight check time
definition: Register passenger and carry-on mass

name: walk holding area to gate
definition: Walk from waiting area to gate door

name: enter gate
definition: Door to aircraft proximity

name: leave gate
definition: Aircraft proximity to terminal door after deboarding

name: access control time
definition: Access control replacing full screening
notes: Feldhoff and Soares Roque 2021; stated assumption without citation.

name: station LoS thresholds
definition: Maximum wait per station (counter; self-service; security; weight check)
notes: Feldhoff 2022 Tables 5-6 IATA first-class/fast-track; alternative time-factor set 200;20;100. Not satisfaction.

name: peak DC charging power envelope
definition: Range of OEM-reported peak DC charging power
notes: NREL 2023 anonymised OEM survey; not Eve/Joby; do not convert to duration.
